verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a self-serve export (for example a CSV download). The only route is building your own extraction on the V4 API: an account-level API key [kit-docs-30], cursor-paginated list endpoints of up to 1000 records per page [kit-docs-34][kit-docs-53], custom field listing [kit-docs-38], and engagement data limited to broadcast-level stats and 5-year email stats retention [kit-docs-36][kit-docs-76]. The unsubscribed and bounced events appear only as forward-looking webhooks [kit-docs-55], not as an exportable suppression list. Missing for 10: a documented one-click export in an open format; explicit coverage of tags and custom field values per subscriber in an export; per-subscriber engagement history export; a suppression list export; independent corroboration.
